description: This file is a React component for the homepage of a real estate web application. It includes UI components such as banners and property listings, fetches data at build time, and exports the main Home component.

methods.name: Banner
methods.description: A React functional component that displays a banner with an image, purpose, titles, description, and a button linking to a specified URL.

methods.name: getStaticProps
methods.description: An async function that fetches property data for sale and rent at build time and passes it as props to the Home component.
